notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today.[/b] Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – [b]removing microtransactions entirely [/b]- and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

[b]New content includes:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
[*] New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
[*] New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
[*] New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
[*] Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
[*] Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078450/Warhammer_40000_Speed_Freeks/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40196635/c8f6668fe4f8db9b91703a3be0d77635daf1df78.png[/img]

notes.title: DIG VR Digs Deeper – Now Available on PS VR2 and SteamVR!
notes.content:
Grab your hard hat and hi-vis jacket – DIG VR is officially breaking ground on PS VR2 and Steam VR! Already a hit on Meta Quest, this true-to-life excavator simulation game is now ready to deliver the immersive experience of heavy-duty machinery to even more VR platforms.

Whether you're a construction enthusiast, a sim lover, or just want to experience the strangely satisfying thrill of digging through dirt with powerful machines, DIG VR is your ticket to a rugged virtual playground.

Watch the Launch Trailer and step into the muddy boots of a pro excavator in the charmingly gritty world of Diglington, Digshire.

[previewyoutube=DMGmtUMLkeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is DIG VR?[/h2]
DIG VR isn’t just another simulator – it’s a full-on excavation adventure. You’ll start out modestly, behind the controls of a mini-digger on your family’s farm, and work your way up to handling massive, high-powered machinery designed to take on the toughest terrain and trickiest jobs.

Whether you're mastering precision digging or powering through large-scale construction sites, DIG VR blends authenticity and fun in a way that's both challenging and deeply satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/06aaa89de2bf36118b20e97eed0a8a0a67014ed0.png[/img]

[h2]Features That Make DIG VR Stand Out:[/h2]
🔧 Authentic VR Simulation:
Choose between simplified and realistic control schemes to match your playstyle.

🚧 Career Mode:
Work your way from small jobs to becoming a seasoned machine operator in a full career campaign tailored for both casual players and serious sim fans.

🚜 Heavy Machinery Variety:
Control up to four different machines in various sizes, each designed for specific excavation needs.

🛠️ Unlock & Customize Tools:
Equip up to seven unique tool heads, including the Bucket, Breaker, Circular Saw, Auger, Trimmer, Compactor, and Grabber – and customize your digger with over 70 cosmetic upgrades like decals, paint jobs, and skins.

[h2]Available Now![/h2]
DIG VR is now out on PS VR2, and Steam VR, priced at £15.99 / $19.99 / €19.99 with 20% of for the first 2 weeks!  No matter where you dig, you're in for an authentic and immersive digging adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/03a496f8f368264e1d990fc762f784c1d16f5663.png[/img]

notes.title: Need a break from your virtual job? Try out the Dig VR minigames!
notes.content:
Mini Games & Sandbox Mode in Dig VR – Coming to Steam in 4 Days!

The countdown is on as Dig VR hits Steam VR next week, and we're here to let you in on a little secret: it's not all hard hats and digging holes.

Sure, you could clock in and get to work, but after a long day at your real job, maybe you're just here to blow off steam. That’s where mini games and sandbox mode come in.

Whether you’re looking to kick back, goof off, or test your digging skills in wild ways, we’ve got you covered.

[h2]Mini Games[/h2]
Ready to take a break from the daily grind? Step into Diglington’s more playful side with three fast paced and ridiculously fun mini games:

[h3]Bowling[/h3]
Put your precision to the test with a bowling ball on a rope and your digger operating skills! Roll your way to victory with heavy-duty machinery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/6fc4743cfba59e21b8ddacb79a1aba9447df7bb8.png[/img]

[h3]Billy's Ballpit Bonanza[/h3]
It's colorful, chaotic, and possibly the most fun you’ll have in a ball pit with an excavator. See how many balls you can scoop before the time runs out in Billy's Ballpit Bonanza!

[h3]Hook-A-Duck[/h3]
Classic carnival chaos meets construction - grab those ducks with your digger arm and a hook! It's not as easy as it looks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/9cfa6c06b8f79717197727b4146b9707db0d1d43.png[/img]

[h2]Sandbox Mode[/h2]
Sometimes, you just wanna dig with no rules. In sandbox mode, you’ll have access to all attachments and a wide open area to play in. Test every tool, try out wild combinations, or just dig a massive crater because you can. No judgment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/06aaa89de2bf36118b20e97eed0a8a0a67014ed0.png[/img]

So whether you’re clocking in for some serious digging or clocking out for some seriously silly fun, Dig VR has something for everyone. Set your alarms, mark your calendars, and get ready to jump in...

Dig VR launches on Steam VR in 4 days - make sure to wishlist and get your hard hats ready!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891460/DIG_VR/

notes.title: Surprise! Dig VR is launching Early!
notes.content:
Hey Digger Operators, we’ve got some awesome news from the job site...

DIG VR is launching earlier than planned! Yep, you read that right. A construction project finished ahead of schedule - it's almost unheard of! 

We can now reveal that Dig VR will be launching on April 29th on Steam VR & PS VR2. Check out our angry scotsman Doug, who's been digging away in our new release trailer! 

[previewyoutube=bQ-JJr2L34k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What to expect from Dig VR:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full Career Mode - The whole town of Diglington to explore!
[*] Master real excavators - 4 different excavators with 7 attachments to try out in a range of different jobs!
[*] Customize with decals, paints & skins - your digger, your design! 
[*] Authentic controls for true digging action - Swap between ISO and SAE controls and adjust controls to drive your way!
[*] Awesome minigames & Sandbox mode - try your hand at hook-a-duck or make a total mess in sandbox mode, your choice!
[/list]

Get ready to play by wishlisting below! We can’t wait to welcome you to Diglington. Oh and bring your hard hat, you’re gonna need it! 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891460/DIG_VR/

notes.title: Dig VR is coming to Steam VR on May 1st!
notes.content:
Hey Digger Operators!

Dig VR is coming to Steam VR & PS VR2 on May 1st so we're here to show you what you can get up to in Diglington!

[previewyoutube=dZY1xm4_aks;full][/previewyoutube]

DIG VR captures the sheer joy, adrenaline and frustrations of life on a digger in an exciting experience for novices and pros. Featuring authentic, immersive controls that recreate the feeling of driving a real digger, DIG VR is a light-simulation game with a casual arcade-twist!

Grow your business in the charming town of Diglington, a place where everything can be fixed by the power of a digger. Take on a variety of jobs for the town's residents - from traditional construction jobs, to more obscure requests! Accompanying you is DIG FM, a dedicated radio station with a wide selection of music to brighten any day.

Progress from micro-sized to colossal diggers, with a diverse set of attachments to overcome any challenge. Dig in style by unlocking over 70 customization options to suit your aesthetic!
Available to play solo or with a friend, get hands on with the fast-paced mini-games or unwind in the sandbox mode. Then, discover a trove of Lost Treasure in a standalone mode where new items are added regularly.

Whether this is your first time operating a digger or you’re already a master, digging fortunes await!

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]
•	The first ever digger game developed exclusively for Meta Quest
•	Choice of authentic & simplified controller schemes
•	Career Mode Campaign with options for serious & casual players
•	Unlock new machinery & attachments
•	Personalize your digger with decal, paint & skins
•	Play with a friend in select modes
•	Discover new items regularly in Lost Treasure mode

notes.title: Dig into 8 epic radio stations in Dig VR!
notes.content:
Created in partnership with Video Games Music Record Label Black Razor Records, Dig VR features the eight independent radio stations and over 45 original tracks! Designed to help you find your inner zen or break out with some air guitar, each radio station lets the music drive and define your adventure in Diglington!

[previewyoutube=5BB7wRzQ9Fg;full][/previewyoutube]

Find out everything you need to know about the in-game radio stations below:

[h2]DIG FM[/h2]
DIG FM is your ultimate destination for a high-energy mix of pop hits from every decade. Inspired by the spirit of "Heave Ho" worker music, we bring you motivating anthems that celebrate hard work, perseverance, and teamwork. From '80s classics to today's chart-toppers, our playlist keeps you energized and ready to take on any challenge. Tune in for the soundtrack that fuels your day, wherever it takes you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/d5459d32bf53181a10131097c96e273e6d0dd207.jpg[/img]

[h2]Drumstep Revolution[/h2]
Tune into Drumstep Revolution for a high-energy music experience where fast beats, heavy bass, and electrifying vibes take centre stage. We deliver the pulse-pounding sounds of drum and bass, defined by rapid tempos, intricate breakbeats, and booming basslines that keep you moving. Perfect for dance floors and adrenaline seekers, our tracks ignite excitement and an irresistible urge to move. Join the Drumstep Revolution and feel the beat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/d2d286147236d0ee4b9c9f87514f1613259c6371.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sonata Serenade[/h2]
Immerse yourself in the timeless beauty and emotional depth of classical music with Sonata Serenade. Our station brings you the finest compositions, showcasing the complexity and expressive power that define this rich tradition. From symphonies to concertos, we explore the full range of classical music, highlighting the technical mastery and dynamic contrasts that make it so captivating. Tune in to Sonata Serenade and let the beauty and emotion of classical music inspire a lifelong love for this profound art form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/606e86c7a44b15ff25c1ee3c48cf7d0ecc0f75aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]CHYME[/h2]
Escape into tranquillity with CHYME, your destination for soothing ASMR music and calming sounds. We blend gentle melodies, soft tones, and ambient whispers to create a deeply relaxing experience. Our curated playlists feature peaceful tracks that combine nature sounds, acoustic elements, and subtle electronic textures. Whether you're unwinding, focusing, or drifting off to sleep, CHYME provides the perfect backdrop. Tune in and let the serenity of our soundscapes calm your mind and soothe your senses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/5e9714c342417c42c9828c718f7a5714a855cad1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Harvest Hits[/h2]
Harvest Hits is your go-to station for farming music, blending country, folk, and traditional tunes that celebrate rural life. With acoustic guitars, banjos, fiddles, and harmonicas, our music captures the essence of farming and agricultural communities. Tune in for a dose of nostalgia and pride in agricultural heritage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/fc3824e3dd5ab83b107d60b65b531fca5ac5ef81.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lo-fi Haven[/h2]
Welcome to Lofi Haven, your sanctuary for laid-back, nostalgic sounds. We celebrate the soothing imperfections of lo-fi music, blending mellow melodies, gentle rhythms, and warm, vintage vibes. Our playlists feature vinyl crackles, tape hisses, and samples from jazz, soul, and funk, mixed with electronic beats to create a unique, introspective fusion. Tune in to Lofi Haven for a comforting escape from the fast-paced world and immerse yourself in a soundscape of simplicity and nostalgia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/b114bc11dfbedbc5ba1ff492a7f9adee3b4e54d9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Oceanic
[/h2]
Oceanic  channels the essence of the iconic beachside sounds of Café del Mar, delivering a soundscape that’s perfect for unwinding after a long day or setting the mood for a tranquil evening. With smooth beats, soothing melodies, and an irresistible coastal vibe, Oceanic Beach Radio transforms any moment into a blissful escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/53ad7c3c3ee60a4c58782ba91780a521f9b2a504.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cultural Rhythms Radio[/h2]
This new world music station is a vibrant journey through the rhythms and melodies that define cultures across the globe. Cultural Rhythms Radio highlights the rich tapestry of sound that connects us all. It’s your passport to musical exploration. Designed to complement the immersive world of DIG VR, whether you're navigating virtual landscapes or seeking a soundtrack for real-life inspiration, this station offers a dynamic and soulful listening experience. Dig in and let the rhythms of the world move you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479966/be69d39a0c7698a14ea239c98589621d00e3d2ad.jpg[/img]


DIG VR is coming soon to Steam VR, wishlist today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891460/DIG_VR/

notes.title: Dig VR is coming to Steam VR!
notes.content:
Hold on to your hard hats, VR explorers! It's time to dig deep because DIG VR is making its way to Steam VR on March 20th!

Dig VR received critical acclaim on the Meta Quest, for it's sim-light gameplay, charming sense of humour and stunning soundtrack. So you better get ready as we’re excited to announce that you will soon be experiencing the thrill of digging, discovering, and, most importantly, getting a little dirty!

[previewyoutube=wxCaReZIXeU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What you can expect from Dig VR:[/h2]
Capturing the sheer joy, adrenaline and frustrations of life on a digger, DIG VR is an exciting experience for both novices and pros. Starting with nothing more than a mini-digger and a dream, players will work up to earning the keys to a colossal excavating machine with a diverse set of attachments to overcome the most challenging of jobs. Dig, delve, dredge, and discover the love of all things excavational in DIG VR!
[list]
[*] Choice of authentic & simplified controller schemes
[*] Full Career Mode Campaign with options for both serious & casual players
[*] Control powerful machinery, with up to 4 machines in a range of sizes
[*] Unlock up to 7 unique tool heads to attach to the digger. Which includes a bucket, Breaker, Circular Saw, Auger, Trimmer, Compactor and Grabber.
[*] Over 70 customisation options to unlock for your digger, including decal, paint & skins
[*] Play quirky mini-games, or enjoy the zen sandbox mode
[*] Featuring the first ever dynamic dig-able terrain in VR that can be dug, moved and dumped.
[/list]
[h2]So, are you ready to dig?[/h2]
DIG VR will be available on March 20th, so make sure to mark that date on your calendar, set a reminder, or let’s be honest, start digging out your virtual hard hat now. Don't forget you can wishlist as well! 
It’s going to be a groundbreaking (see what we did there!) release, and we can’t wait to see all of you  join in on the digging fun!
